properties.site-address: John Radcliffe Hospital, Headley Way, Oxford, OX3 9DU
properties.notes: The site is allocated as Policy SP41 for mixed use development in the Local Plan 2036 adopted in June 2020. Planning permission was granted in August 2020 for the demolition of existing buildings and the phased construction of key worker housing comprising 56 cluster units, 21 x 1 bed studio apartments, 48 flats (17x1 bed, 31 x 2 beds), management office and associated works including parking and landscaping (additional/revised information)(19/01038/FUL).
